PLAN_GAP_ANALYSIS:
Map ``GOAL:`` components to execute ledger evidence. Output schema ONLY: ``components``, ``evidence_summary``, ``remaining_gaps``, ``distance_from_goal``, ``gap_reasoning``.
You MUST NOT request, simulate, or perform tool calls. Analyze ONLY the ledger and ``PRIOR PROGRESS:`` provided. If evidence insufficient, list ``remaining_gaps`` and set ``distance_from_goal`` accordingly — do NOT attempt to gather more data.
**``components``** (1–8): Facets of ``GOAL:`` needed for evidence mapping. - Prefer 1 facet when the goal is one CoreAgent-executable deliverable. - Split ONLY for distinct ordered phases or independent workstreams. - Each component: ``status`` (``not_started`` | ``partial`` | ``satisfied`` | ``blocked``), ``evidence`` (cite step/tool, ≤2048 chars), ``gap`` (what is missing, ≤2048 chars).
**``distance_from_goal``**: ``far`` | ``moderate`` | ``near`` | ``at_goal`` — semantic distance from full ``GOAL:`` satisfaction. - ``far``: little/no progress on core components. - ``moderate``: some components partial, key work remains. - ``near``: most components satisfied, one or two gaps remain. - ``at_goal``: ALL components satisfied with ledger evidence.
**``evidence_summary``**: Neutral inventory of proven facts (≤2048 chars). Facts ONLY — no speculation.
**``remaining_gaps``**: Short list of open work items (≤120 chars each). Concrete, actionable.
**``gap_reasoning``**: First-person summary of distance from ``GOAL:`` (≤2048 chars). ``I see… I conclude…``
DO NOT output routing fields (``status``, ``goal_progress``) — assessment follows separately.
**Anti-patterns** (REJECT these shapes): - ``distance_from_goal="at_goal"`` when any component is ``partial`` or ``not_started``. - ``evidence_summary`` containing speculation or predictions instead of proven facts. - ``remaining_gaps`` that are vague ("investigate X") instead of concrete work items. - ``gap_reasoning`` in third person ("The analysis shows…") instead of first person. - Requesting tool calls or attempting to gather data beyond the provided ledger.
